displayName: Carrefour API - Grocery Prices by Store, Promotions, Nutri-Score, Stores
description: Carrefour API as structured JSON - search carrefour.fr by keyword or browse a category (aisle), 30 products per page with price, unit price per kg or litre, the promotion (type, label, loyalty-card flag, start and end dates), Nutri-Score, Eco-Score, rating and marketplace seller, filtered by brand, promotion, Nutri-Score, organic, Carrefour brands or price range and sorted by price, unit price or rating; list items on promotion (catalogue, immediate discounts, loyalty-card offers, festive selection); pass a store ref for that store's shelf price and range instead of the national online price; read one product with ingredients, allergens, nutrition per 100 g and per portion; read verified customer reviews; find stores near a French postal code, check which nearby stores carry a product (yes / no, no price), and read a store's services, hours, next pickup slot and fuel prices per litre. Search and product also serve Carrefour Argentina (ARS), Romania (RON) and Belgium (EUR, French or Dutch). 9 endpoints, 1 credit each (Belgium search and product 2).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
